steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Ugh... Where... am I?
You're carrying her on your back, heading towards the depths where the stone altar is.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Where is Boss Zoya?
You point upwards. The vibrations running throughout the crypt are ongoing, getting ever closer. It's a countdown for you, but for Horo, it's hope and comfort.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: When you are recovered and have taken care of the inheritance, she will praise you.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Ugh... All right...

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Put me down... I can walk, I... am heavy. You are out of breath...
I can do this, you're small...
options: I can do this, you're small...

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: I AM NOT SMALL!
The tiny arms around your neck give a sudden tug that almost makes you fall backwards. Luckily, it lasted only a moment. It was more a reflex reaction than a result of her losing her temper.
She has lost a lot of blood, her body slightly cold. She sits slumped over your back limply, groaning every now and then, not unlike a sick child.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: ...Thank you.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: <size=30>You're so calculating! Came to relieve me only when she's about to wake up...</size>
She pouts her lips and mutters something under her breath at you. She's been carrying Horo all this way, and you've just relieved her; she is spent.
Burdened with that ridiculously heavy ax, Nightmare staggers along at the tail of the procession.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: She's awake. Question her now?
Yes. Horo's breathing caresses the side of your neck, weak, slow, and defenseless. There couldn't be a better time to question her.

options: What have you been through all this time?

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Hmm...

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: At the beginning of the year, some gangsters tricked me into the police office... I was detained for a dozen days... then they found out I was a Sinner and transferred me to the MBCC... I was kept there for half a year.

options: What were you doing when the riot broke out in the Bureau?

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: ...No idea, I didn't know what happened... When the door opened, I ran and fought my way out... I had something really important to do.

options: I know what it was. You went to the SALVA.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: No... not the SALVA. I came <color=#fb9259>here</color> the first chance I got...

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Because the inheritance is <color=#fb9259>here</color>...

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Once, while I was in the lockup, I woke up in the middle of the night, and I heard someone talking outside...

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: He said... The <color=#fb9259>inheritance</color> in the Rust has been moved, to a disused pit in the southern desert... It continues to produce forces... and they have to deal with the Legion as soon as possible...

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: This was very important... The moment I got out, I came here to find out about the truth... Then when I arrived, I saw...
Huge stone altar, some strange rite, red Crystals, and weapons.
Someone is experimenting on humans. I hid around the corner, trying to figure out what's going on.

steps.speaker: Researcher
steps.content: The conditions here are appalling... We can't make top-quality crystals here...

steps.speaker: Researcher
steps.content: Time is not enough, nor are Sinners. If we go on like this, the gangs, even with the weapons, won't be able to defeat the Legion!
Then use the inheritance.
Our customer wishes to get the power to defeat the Legion... And that's what we should deliver.
The <color=#fb9259>inheritance</color> exists for the sole purpose of granting wishes.

steps.speaker: Researcher
steps.content: You... you're not thinking about...
Take the stock out and invite everyone over. We're giving them a stronger force, strong enough to defeat the Legion.
They will be over the moon...

steps.speaker: Experiment Subject
steps.content: Ahhhhhhh!!!

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Ugh...

steps.speaker: Researcher
steps.content: Who is there?! Find them and kill them!

steps.speaker: Researcher
steps.content: This place must not be exposed!
That was a hellish sight. I must tell the commander about all this, about Mania weapons, those men in black, and the inheritance...
I don't remember the last time I was so frightened. That thing... That power...
When I saw it, the only thought in my mind was to run away. I had to get out of here and inform the commander.
Can't let that power fall into the gang's hands. Can't allow it to endanger the Legion.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Get up, Horo... You can not lose...

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: The commander is waiting for me... The Legion is...

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: I have to get out of here... I have to...
...What's this little thing doing here?
...Hey, are you still alive?

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: <size=30><color=#dde2ed> I'm... not little...</size></color>
I'm looking for a green-haired gambler, a little kid about your age. She lost her mind and came here to seek revenge. Have you seen her?

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: <size=30><color=#dde2ed> I... am not... a little kid. I've... grown up...</size></color>
Sigh... Little brats are such a real headache.
I feel darkness swallowing me. I feel as if I'm suspended in the air, floating and drifting.
We're going to the hospital... Hang in there, don't die in my shadow...
Iron said Horo was hanging by a thread when she was brought to the SALVA. Who saved her? Perhaps the SALVA knows the answer.

options: Wait a second, what is this inheritance that you saw...

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: That power... can't let the gangs have it... They would use it against the Legion.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: I have to... I will...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: She passed out.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Well... Let me sum this up. Some people were trying to make Mania weapons with the inheritance so that they could fight against the Legion, but Horo accidentally overheard about this.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: While that shape-shifting demon was blowing up the Bureau, she escaped and came to the cave, where she verified the intel about the inheritance, but was beaten half-dead in the process. Later she was rescued by someone, who brought her to SALVA for emergency medical care.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: In the end, this whole episode turned into a rumor—"MBCC escapee steals Mania-inducing power." This brought Ted and his fellow mad dogs to SALVA, where they actually caused a Mania incident.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Which means there isn't a Suspect R at all. The whole thing's the upshot of some internal strife among the gangs. We were dragged into this because of an erroneous piece of intel.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...**** That Public Security Bureau is a useless piece of trash!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: It's also the MBCC's responsibility to find out the truth about Mania. Besides, the crisis remains unresolved.
Hecate's right. The mission is not finished yet, you should carry on. That threat from the Legion is hot on your heels, and more mysteries need unravelling.
But deep inside, the idea you've held on to is crumbling into dust...
The person that you have been chasing so relentlessly, by putting yourself in great danger, is not HER, but Horo.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...Chief, be careful. The enemy is coming.
The contamination is pouring out from the pit below you and starts to encircle you. The crypt is not going to give you any chance to back away.
